scope: Host fork instrumentation only; identical original SDK-link inputs; three fresh serial runs per backend, alternating order. CLI includes Binaryen Os. Raw physical footprint excludes Binaryen. Independent Node compilation and artifact-policy validation; no guest execution.

metadata.scope: Complete transforms with common immutable I/O, feature metadata, serial structural validation, atomic publication and checksums; no Binaryen or guest execution in raw transforms. Optional CLI Os timings include Binaryen but do not measure its child-process memory. Separate Node compile/contract checks.
